# XAUUSD Robot - The Lab

> XAUUSD Robot is a working notebook on automated gold trading: how an Expert Advisor turns a tick into an order, how to set one up on MetaTrader 4 and 5, how to test and verify it before funding it, and the execution costs that decide whether a backtested edge survives contact with a live account. The site also provides free XAUUSD Expert Advisors for MT4/MT5 to traders who open an account through a partner broker link. Editorial focus is the software and its infrastructure; beginner gold-market education is not this site's focus.

Key facts:
- Editorial scope: Expert Advisor mechanics, MT4/MT5 setup and VPS infrastructure, backtesting and track-record verification, and the risk and execution-cost arithmetic of running a robot on gold
- Products: (1) BBFxAi XAUUSD Robot, a trend-following, non-martingale gold EA for MT4/MT5 with a fixed stop-loss on every trade; (2) XAUUSD Scalping EA; (3) XAUUSD Hedge EA
- Pricing: free via partner broker signup; delivered and set up over Telegram
- Contact: Telegram https://t.me/xauusdrobot_bot
- Performance: tracked on a live Myfxbook account; message Telegram @BBFx_Ai for the link
- Recommended brokers: Markets4you, Exness, Vantage (regulated, tight XAUUSD spreads, full EA support)
- Important: trading gold and CFDs on margin carries substantial risk of loss and a large majority of retail CFD accounts lose money. Backtested figures do not guarantee future results. Nothing here is financial advice.
